description: Total revenue (net sales after discounts), total number of orders and total units sold across the entire order history of the company.
sample_questions: What are our total sales of all time?|How much revenue has the company made overall?|How many orders have we received in total?

description: Total sales, number of orders and units sold in the last month (the most recent complete calendar month in the data).
sample_questions: What were total sales last month?|How much did we sell in the previous month?|How many orders did we get last month?

description: Yearly (annual) sales trend over all years: number of orders and total revenue for each calendar year.
sample_questions: How have sales changed year over year?|Show revenue by year|Which year had the highest sales?

description: Top 10 customers ranked by the total amount of money they spent, with their country and number of orders.
sample_questions: Which customer spent the most?|Who are our best customers?|List the biggest buyers by spend

description: Top 10 products ranked by the revenue (sales amount in dollars) they generated, with category and units sold.
sample_questions: Which products bring in the most money?|What are the highest revenue products?|Top products by sales value

description: Top 10 best-selling products ranked by number of units (quantity) sold, i.e. the products customers order most often.
sample_questions: What are the best-selling products by quantity?|Which product sold the most units?|Most popular products by volume

description: Revenue and units sold for each product category, including each category's percentage share of total revenue.
sample_questions: Which product category sells the most?|Show sales by category|What share of revenue does each category make up?

description: Sales performance of each employee or sales representative: number of orders handled and revenue generated.
sample_questions: Which employee generated the most sales?|Who is the top salesperson?|How are the sales reps performing?

description: Number of orders and revenue by country the orders were shipped to: which countries we sell to the most (geographic sales breakdown).
sample_questions: Which country generates the most revenue?|Show sales by country|Where do most of our orders go?

description: Comparison of shipping companies (carriers): orders shipped, average freight cost, average days to ship and percentage of late deliveries per shipper.
sample_questions: Which shipping company is the fastest?|Compare the shippers|Which carrier has the lowest freight cost?

description: How many orders were shipped late (after the required date), the percentage of late orders and the average number of days late.
sample_questions: How many orders were delivered late?|What percentage of shipments missed the required date?|Are we shipping on time?

description: Active products that are low on stock: units in stock at or below the reorder level, with units on order and supplier.
sample_questions: Which products need to be reordered?|What items are running low on inventory?|Show low stock products

description: List of products that have been discontinued and are no longer sold, with category, price and remaining stock.
sample_questions: Which products are discontinued?|What products have we stopped selling?|List discontinued items

description: Average order value in dollars, average number of products and units per order, and average freight cost per order.
sample_questions: What is the average order value?|How much does a typical order cost?|How many items are in an average order?

description: Month-by-month orders and revenue for last year (the most recent complete calendar year in the data), showing seasonality.
sample_questions: What were monthly sales last year?|Show the monthly revenue trend for last year|Which month was best last year?

description: Orders that have not been shipped yet (pending or open orders), with customer, order date, required date and destination.
sample_questions: Which orders are still pending?|What orders have not shipped yet?|Show open unshipped orders

description: The 10 most expensive products by list unit price, with category and supplier.
sample_questions: What are the most expensive products?|Which product has the highest price?|Show premium high-priced items

description: Number of customers located in each country (customer base distribution).
sample_questions: How many customers do we have in each country?|Which country has the most customers?|Where are our customers located?

description: Impact of discounts: gross revenue before discounts, total discount amount given away, net revenue and the percentage of order lines that were discounted.
sample_questions: How much money did we give away in discounts?|What is the total discount given?|How often do we offer discounts?

description: Number of suppliers (vendors) and products supplied per supplier country.
sample_questions: Which countries are our suppliers from?|How many suppliers do we have per country?|Where do our products come from?

description: Database overview and schema size: every table in the Northwind database with its number of rows (records) and number of columns (fields), plus the totals.
sample_questions: How many rows and columns are in the database?|How many tables are there and how big is each one?|Show the database structure with record counts
